description: This is a C# source file defining the AutoroutePartHandler class, which manages routing and URL generation for content items in OrchardCore CMS, including path validation, uniqueness checks, and route setting.

classes.name: AutoroutePartHandler
classes.description: Handles routing, path validation, and cache management for AutoroutePart in OrchardCore CMS.

methods.name: PublishedAsync
methods.description: Handles actions after a content item is published, including route setup and cache eviction.

methods.name: UnpublishedAsync
methods.description: Handles actions after a content item is unpublished, including updating entries and cache eviction.

methods.name: RemovedAsync
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a content item is removed, updating entries and cache.

methods.name: ValidatingAsync
methods.description: Validates the uniqueness and correctness of the route path.

methods.name: CreatedAsync
methods.description: Generates route paths based on patterns when a content item is created.

methods.name: UpdatedAsync
methods.description: Regenerates route paths when a content item is updated.

methods.name: CloningAsync
methods.description: Handles route path generation for cloned content items, ensuring uniqueness.

methods.name: GetContentItemAspectAsync
methods.description: Provides route-related aspects for content items.

methods.name: SetHomeRouteAsync
methods.description: Sets the site's home route to a specified path.

methods.name: RemoveTagAsync
methods.description: Removes cache tags related to a specific route path.

methods.name: CheckContainedHomeRouteAsync
methods.description: Checks and sets home routes for contained content items.

methods.name: GenerateContainedPathsFromPatternAsync
methods.description: Generates paths for contained content items based on patterns.

methods.name: PopulateContainedContentItemRoutesAsync
methods.description: Recursively populates route entries for contained content items.

methods.name: ValidateContainedContentItemRoutesAsync
methods.description: Validates and ensures unique routes for contained content items.

methods.name: IsRelativePathUnique
methods.description: Checks if a relative path is unique among entries.

methods.name: GenerateRelativeUniquePath
methods.description: Generates a unique relative path by appending version numbers.

methods.name: GenerateContainerPathFromPatternAsync
methods.description: Generates a container path based on a pattern.

methods.name: GetPatternAsync
methods.description: Retrieves the route pattern from content type settings.

methods.name: GenerateUniqueAbsolutePathAsync
methods.description: Creates a unique absolute path by appending version numbers.

methods.name: IsAbsolutePathUniqueAsync
methods.description: Checks if an absolute path is unique in the database.
